sources.name: Repository-Based Investigation of the RABBIT F-10 Blockers

claims.finding: RABBIT F-10 branch 2d866dfd3b0a09b52f4ef5d4191b7d713e084ed9 documented SciPy BDF finite-difference jac_factor ratcheting, inaccurate columns, Newton failure, repeated resets and order stagnation; measured true operator spectral abscissae near -5.75. This is a specific numerical pathology, not universal BDF failure.
claims.action: Retain as motivation/negative fixture; do not transfer RABBIT admission rules or model identity to VigilODE.

claims.finding: SABR5P exact block reformulation and affine one-block closure existed. Cheap CPU prototype lost (median speedup0.823), synthetic latency crossover was not real hardware parallelism. Finite nonnormal screens did not prove a general certificate.
claims.action: Compare current coupled solver with exact original-target block identity; retain forward baseline and total attempt costs.

claims.finding: 2026-08-08 canonical catalog already includes sequential GCRODR off/stage/persistent. One recorded trace: GMRES-off median0.018760089s,3077 operators; GCRODR-persistent0.025526891s,2312 operators. Hence fewer operators did not guarantee less time; older 'GCRODR unimplemented' closeout is superseded for catalog presence.
claims.action: Inspect current implementation and quality before planning a duplicate GCRODR port.

claims.finding: Ordinary same-step Rosenbrock-W with order p for every bounded W has RHS DAG depth D>=p by W=0 explicit-RK specialization. Exact-J, restricted W-J, higher jets and peer/multivalue are outside that scoped argument.
claims.action: Do not claim universal eight-stage impossibility; test actual tableau DAG and altered-method order separately.

claims.finding: RJ5 has stiff PR order reduction; raw RVJ has semilinear two-step max-grid counterexample with error/h^3→4/3 at kappa=h^-6; embedded difference can underestimate true local error by ~|z|/5. Approximate-W substitutions can destroy stiff behavior.
claims.action: Preserve these as exact regression obligations for any jet route; no embedded-only admission.

claims.finding: Invariant-ideal/Darboux identities, regular charts, approximate-cofactor remainder, root-ball contraction, branch witness and monodromy were constructed in independent L01-L04. Pseudo-arclength regularity does not select physical real-time branch; uq-1 has root escape without finite discriminant.
claims.action: Port only source-owned chart/branch descriptors with denominator/domain/initial transverse data and reconstruction error.

claims.finding: Rank-three algebra C[xi]/(xi^3-s^2xi) retains multiplicity as roots coalesce. Stable confluent sinhc formulas, even/odd sharing, and shifted-resolvent jet reuse were derived. 65-shift probe reduced65factorizations/130scalar solves to1/36 but retained jet depth18.
claims.action: Do not delete odd/transverse information or use singular eigenvector inversion; benchmark against multi-shift Krylov/Schur reuse.

claims.finding: L10-L12 distinguish Fourier consistency from alias/tail control; original residual certifies FFT predictor. Known frequency packet + rank-one mean feedback admits aggregate Volterra kernel and individual-mode reconstruction; kernel arithmetic changes n(p+1)(df+1)→(p+1)(df+1) under exact same projection.
claims.action: Port as structural optional provider only when compiler proves source structure; keep generic fallback and full output costs.

claims.finding: V01/V02 record raw-stage JVP removal, radius/Laguerre work and PR70 native re-audit. Integrated report says those were already historical implementation work, not new unimplemented tasks.
claims.action: Inspect PR70/current descendants; avoid replaying old proposals as new obligations.

claims.finding: Causal cache retained108/108 bits; nonlinear cell RHS58→37,block56→35, but forward16RHS/8solve remained cheaper. Full trajectory RHS1868→1702,block1456→1290,JVP726 unchanged. A1.395x root-attempt timing had outer WRMS≈4.62e4 and was rejected, not accepted-trajectory speedup.
claims.action: Reuse exact-input/prefix cache contracts; charge all rejected attempts and compare full trajectories.

claims.finding: For f=b-dy+kappa mean(y)1, d>=kappa>=0, P/Q decomposition yields two scalar tableaux plus all-component lift.64step run RHS1024→576,shifted solves512→0. Full transverse initial/forcing components retained. Historical n2048 one-worker median1.883x; two-worker range crossed1.
claims.action: Current code target structural_mean_field.rs; retain source type, all-state residual and complete cost. Stage algebra certificate is not full physical-time error.

claims.finding: RHS homotopy uses actual-residual dominance; monotone cubic midpoint root error residual/(1+hk/2), nonexpansivity and finite-step budget. Warm-start savings isolated from Anderson. Adapter compares same-window completed work using checked integers and incumbent ties; no future optimality.
claims.action: Reuse rhs_homotopy.rs and switching.rs; do not label causal projected-JVP path fully derivative-free.

claims.finding: PR92 development plan already contains production serialization/permissions, charged structural attempts, cubic inverse, L-RELEASE/L-HARDWARE, PR-N01..06, Q-ledger/Givens/fair-AB/benchmark/API/negative obligations. Supported scope smooth forward identity-mass endpoint IVP; release pending then.
